|meaning=|footnotes=}} The '''Singhania family''' is a prominent Indian business family, that started out in the Indian city of [[Kanpur]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.jkkids.in/about-us-2/jk-organisation/|title=JK Kids - JK Organisation|website=www.jkkids.in|language=en|access-date=2018-05-07}}{{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/kanpur/JK-Group-remembers-Kamlapat/articleshow/5207482.cms|title=JK Group remembers Kamlapat - Times of India|work=The Times of India|access-date=2018-05-07}}{{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/singhanias-settle-3-decade-old-property-feud-before-sc/articleshow/59474608.cms|title=Singhanias settle 3-decade old property feud before SC - Times of India|work=The Times of India|access-date=2018-05-07}} The family expanded into three major branches and is currently based out of [[Kanpur]], [[Mumbai]] and [[Delhi]]. [[JK Organisation]] founded by [[Lala Kamlapat Singhania]] is one of the largest [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerates]] in India today, with multiple million and billion dollar companies under its belt. The family owns majority stakes in several publicly listed companies such as [[JK Tyre]], JK Cement, JK Lakshmi Cement, JK Paper, Jaykay Enterprises, JK Agri Genetics (JK Seeds) and JK Dairy (Umang Dairies).{{Cite web|url=http://forum.valuepickr.com/t/umang-dairies-turn-around-company-by-jk-group/1524|title=Umang Dairies: Turn around company by JK Group|website=ValuePickr Forum|language=en|access-date=2018-02-28|date=31 May 2015}}{{Cite web|url=http://www.jkcement.com/the_company|title=JK Cement - Company Profile|website=www.jkcement.com|access-date=2018-02-28}} Some privately held companies in the family are [[Raymond Group]], J.K. Ansell, JK Tech, JK Fenner, JK Insurance brokers and Global Strategic Technologies.{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/corporate/now-gautam-singhania-wants-to-make-raymond-soar/story/229416.html|title=The 'Complete Man' undergoing changes- Business News|website=www.businesstoday.in|date=27 February 2016 |access-date=2018-02-28}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.jkorg.in/index.php/businesses/dwarkesh-energy|title=Dwarkesh Energy|website=www.jkorg.in|access-date=2018-02-28}} ==Family history== As per records of [[JK Temple]] Kanpur, Vinodi Das Singhania left his home in [[Singhana, Rajasthan|Singhana]] - a little town in the [[Jhunjhunu district]] of Rajasthan - in 1775. He resettled in [[Farrukhabad]], a small business town near Kanpur. He started off as a Banker and diversified into trading. This was the time when [[East India Company]] was entering India. His sons - Ramsukhdas and Sarbsukhdas - later joined the family business and opened branch offices in Kanpur, [[Kolkata]], [[Varanasi]] and [[Mirzapur]].{{Cite news|url=http://www.marwar.com/people/tribute/juggilal-kamlapat-venerable-architects-of-the-jk-group.html|title=Juggilal & Kamlapat: Venerable architects of the JK Group - Marwar|date=2016-06-10|work=Marwar|access-date=2018-05-06|language=en-US}} After Ramsukhdas and Sarbsukhdas, the business was passed on to Ramsukhdas' son, Sewaram. Baldeodas took over the reins of the business along with his brother Munnalal from his father Sewaram. During this time the family also earned the royal title of 'Rajah Sahib'{{Citation needed|date=August 2023}} . Baldeodas had six sons and among them was Juggilal who took over the family business and played an important role in expanding and diversifying the business from bankers and traders to industrialists.{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=rc0tAAAAMAAJ&q=lala+kamlapat+singhania|title=The Aggarwals: a socio-economic study|last=Gupta|first=Badlu Ram|date=1975|publisher=S. Chand|isbn=9780883867150|language=en}}{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=PMEtAAAAMAAJ&q=baldevdas+munna+lal+singhania|title=Lakshmipat Singhania: his concepts and creations|last=Rao|first=P. Chentsal|date=July 1986|publisher=Vikas|isbn=9780706930474|language=en}} In 1905, Juggilal and his family shifted to their Kanpur house after a division in the family business which then owned two flour mills — the Ganges Flour Mill and Cawnpore Flour Mill — apart from being the sole selling agents for Elgin Mills, Cawnpore Cotton Mills and Victoria Mills. The division created two new business units - Baldeodas-Kedarnath and Baijnath-Juggilal. Baijnath-Juggilal was controlled and managed by Juggilal and his elder son.{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qQdDDwAAQBAJ&q=Baldeo+Das-Kedarnath+and+Baijnath-Juggilal&pg=PA58|title=Kanpur Unveiled|last=Trivedi|first=Preeti|date=2017-12-01|publisher=Bhartiya Sahitya Inc.|isbn=9781613016282|language=en}} After Kamlapat the business was passed on to his three sons - Padampat, Kailashpat and Lakshmipat. Padampat established Straw Products Ltd in 1940 with support from Nawab of Bhopal - [[Hamidullah Khan]]. The brothers set up a gas plant - JK Rampur Gas Plant - with support from [[princely state]] of [[Rampur State|Rampur]]. They also acquired a plant of the [[Aluminium Corporation]] of India in [[Asansol]]. Lakshmipat took the lead in order to make the plant operational. He also established a small steel plant - JK Steels - near Rishra in [[West Bengal]], and a paper mill in [[Odisha]]. The brothers also acquired [[National Insurance Company]] during the period of [[World War II]]. The family supported the British Government during the war years and stepped up the production to meet the needs of British Army. Due to the support given to British Government during the war years, Padampat Singhania was conferred with knighthood at [[Rashtrapati Bhavan|The Viceroy's House]], [[New Delhi]], on 23 February 1943.{{Cite news|url=https://www.thegazette.co.uk/London/issue/35951/page/1373/data.pdf|title=The London Gazette}} In 1944, the family bought a woolen textile mill - Raymond Woollen Mills - in Thane from [[E.D. Sassoon & Co.]] Kailashpat took charge of the company and was instrumental in its growth. Today [[Raymond Group]] is a leading producer of fabrics in India. The business subsequently got divided between the brothers. Padampat took over the north Zone with Kanpur as headquarters. Lakshmipat resettled in [[Kolkata]] and took control of eastern zone while Kailashpat moved to [[Mumbai]] to head the western zone. Later on Lakshmipat moved to Delhi and established it as headquarters for businesses under his control.{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/variety/driven-by-consensus/article22984126.ece|title=Driven by consensus|work=@businessline|access-date=2018-05-07|language=en}} ==Family branches== ===Kanpur branch=== Padampat Singhania continued to manage the businesses from Kanpur while his younger brothers moved to Mumbai and Kolkata. Singhania became the president of the group but the companies operated independently with some cross holdings among them. After Padampat, his eldest son, Gopal Krishna Singhania became president of the company. He was the youngest Chairman of Raymond Woollen Mills Ltd.{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=gcZOAAAAYAAJ |title=Wool & Woollens of India |date=2000 |publisher=Indian Woollen Mills Federation. |language=en}} During the short span of lifetime, he led Raymond to be the top brand and placed Raymond at the head of all exporting woollen mills in India.{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=N8ROAAAAYAAJ&q=gopal+krishna+singhania+legend |title=Wool and Wollens of India |publisher=Indian Wollen mills federation |year=1983 |volume=20 |pages=23 |language=English}} He established joint ventures with Australia to manufacture indigenous merino wools and expanded business to Kenya.{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=gcZOAAAAYAAJ |title=Wool and Wollens of India |publisher=Indian Woolen Mills Federation |year=2000 |volume=37 |pages=19–20 |language=English}}{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=gcZOAAAAYAAJ |title=Globalisation The Indian Scenario |publisher=Wheeler Publications |year=1996 |pages=190 |language=English}} Gopal Krishna had two sons and two daughters namely, Nidhipati Singhania, [[Gopika]] Singhania, Ambika Kothari and Ramapati Singhania. After his untimely death his son Ramapati Singhania joined the Singhania family's JK Group of companies in 1980.  Later he became an UAE expatriate and founded Varal Consultancy, DMCC, Dubai. now known as HabotConnect, DMCC.  Gopal Krishna Singhania’s brother, Gaur Hari Singhania became head of the businesses which were under Kanpur branch of the family. Padampat's younger son Govind Hari Singhania was also involved in the business. After Gaur Hari Singhania's death the business was headed by his son Yadupati Singhania who groomed his nephews Dr.Raghavpat and Madhavkrishna. On 13 August 2020 Yadupati Singhania died in Singapore after a brief illness. Today Raghavpat and Madhavkrishna are managing director and joint managing director of JK Cement respectively. Companies under the control of Dr.Nidhipati, Dr.Raghavpat & Madhavkrishna are: * JK Cement Ltd - The company is one of the largest grey cement producers in India & the third largest manufacturer of white cement in the world, it is also the largest wall putty manufacturer in the world. * JK Maxx Paints Ltd - The company has acquired a decorative paints company "Acro Paints Ltd" in 2023. This makes JK Maxx Paints a substantial player in the Indian decorative paints market. *Yadu International - The company is a holding company off the family assets. *Arr Emm Holdings Pvt Ltd - The company is involved in handloom revival and export of handloom articles. Companies under the control of Abhishek, Son of Govind Hari Singhania, are: *JK Technosoft - The company is involved in software supply. *Jaykay Enterprises Ltd (formerly JK Synthetics Ltd.) - The company was involved in manufacturing of nylon and acrylic fibres, * JK Cotton Ltd - The company was incorporated as a private company on 24 October 1924, originally founded by Kamlapat Singhania.{{Cite web|url=http://www.jkcotton.com/about-company-profile.html|title=J.K. COTTON SPINNING & WEAVING MILLS CO.LTD.|website=www.jkcotton.com|access-date=2018-05-07}} The cotton mill closed in 1989 due to union issues and overall decline of industry in Kanpur. ===Mumbai branch=== The family purchased a textile mill - Raymond Woolen Mills - from ED Sassoon & Co in 1944. Kailashpat Singhania took over the control of the business and moved to Mumbai. After Kailashpat, Gopal Krishna his nephew, took over the business and on his death Vijaypat managed the company. Currently it is being controlled and managed by Vijaypat's eldest son - Gautam Singhania. Companies and brands under control of Mumbai branch of the family are: * Raymond Group - [[India]]n branded fabric and fashion retailer.{{Cite web|url=http://www.raymond.in/theraymondgroup?subcat=130|title=The Raymond Group {{!}} Raymond|website=www.raymond.in|language=en|access-date=2018-05-07}} * Raymond Apparel Ltd - A subsidiary of Raymond group. Brands under Raymond Apparel are Park Avenue, Parx, Ethnix, and ColorPlus.{{Cite web|url=http://www.raymond.in/ourbrands|title=Our brands {{!}} Raymond|website=www.raymond.in|language=en|access-date=2018-05-07}} * JK Files India Limited - Subsidiary of Raymond group and the largest producer of files in the world.{{Cite web|url=http://www.jkfilesandtools.com/|title=JK Files (India) Limited|website=www.jkfilesandtools.com|access-date=2018-05-07}} * JK Ansell - Manufacturers and marketers of [[KamaSutra (brand)|KamaSutra]] condoms. Also a subsidiary of Raymond group India.{{Cite news|url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/9vdzBbvyYjzVuVPCqm0aCJ/Raymond-buys-JV-partners-stake-in-JK-Ansell.html|title=Raymond buys Ansell's stake in their joint venture JK Ansell|last=Gupta|first=Soumya|date=2017-08-17|access-date=2018-05-07}} ===Delhi branch=== In 1942, Kamlapat's youngest son Lakshmipat led the effort for acquisition of Aluminium Corporation of India plant in Asansol. He also established a small steel plant - JK Steels in West Bengal - and a paper mill in Odisha. In 1960s, due to labor union problems in West Bengal and nationalisation of several companies under family's control, the family moved from Kolkata to Delhi. After Lakshmipat, his eldest son Hari Shankar Singhania took over the control of the companies and managed it along with his brothers and other family members.{{Cite news|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/born-to-business-then-had-to-start-afresh-113022500019_1.html|title=Born to business, then had to start afresh|last=Bhandari|first=Bhupesh|date=2013-02-25|work=Business Standard India|access-date=2018-05-07}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/current/policy/singur-tata-jk-group-padampat-singhania/story/16377.html|title=JK Group faced a 'Singur' in Bengal, in 1969!- Business News|website=www.businesstoday.in|date=17 June 2011 |access-date=2018-05-07}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/1141208/jsp/business/story_2528.jsp|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150610033348/http://www.telegraphindia.com/1141208/jsp/business/story_2528.jsp|url-status=dead|archive-date=10 June 2015|title=Singhanias back in Bengal|work=The Telegraph|access-date=2018-05-07}} Major companies under control of Delhi branch of the family are: * JK Tyre - Engaged in manufacturing and marketing of tires and a market leader in radial tires in India. It has a worldwide customer base in over 80 countries across all 6 continents.{{Cite web|url=http://www.jktyre.com/ourheritage.aspx|title=OUR HERITAGE – JK TYRE|website=www.jktyre.com|access-date=2018-05-07}} * JK Paper Ltd - Engaged in manufacturing and marketing of paper products.{{Cite web|url=http://www.jkpaper.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=1&Itemid=3|title=About Us - Paper Manufacturer in India, Coated Paper & Premium Packaging Boards {{!}} JK Paper|last=Administrator|website=www.jkpaper.com|language=en-gb|access-date=2018-05-07}} * JK Lakshmi Cement - Manufacturer of cement and cementitious materials.{{Cite news|url=http://www.jklakshmicement.com/about-jklc-2/|title=About Us – JK Lakshmi|access-date=2018-05-07|language=en-US}} * JK Fenner - The company is engaged in manufacturing of products such as belts, pulleys, couplings, variable speed drives, clutches and gear boxes.{{Cite web|url=http://www.jkfennerindia.com/products.aspx|title=Fenner India - Products|website=www.jkfennerindia.com|access-date=2018-05-07}} * Other Companies - The other companies of the Delhi JK Group are JK Seeds, Umanng Dairy, Global Strategic Technologies (Defence Tech), CliniRx - a clinical research firm, JK Risk Managers (Insurance) and Indica Travels. The Group also runs a superspeciality hospital PSRI, in the National capital which is a world class hospital for heart, liver, renal and gastro diseases apart from other well-equipped divisions which cater to national and international patients across the Globe. The Delhi Group also runs [[JK Lakshmipat University]] near [[Jaipur]] which offers curriculum in engineering, business management and design streams.{{cite web |title=J.K. Organisation |url=http://www.jkorg.in/ |website=www.jkorg.in |access-date=27 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230613215337/https://www.jkorg.in/ |archive-date=Jun 13, 2023 |language=en |url-status=live}} ==Prominent members== * Lala Juggilal Singhania (1857-1922) - Born to Baldeodas in 1857. He was the founder of JK Organisation along with his son Lala Kamlapat Singhania.{{Cite web|url=http://www.jkcotton.com/about-our-founder.html|title=J.K. COTTON SPINNING & WEAVING MILLS CO.LTD.|website=www.jkcotton.com|access-date=2018-05-06}} ** [[Lala Kamlapat Singhania]] (1884-1937) - He was the younger of two sons of Juggilal and founder of JK Organisation *** Kailashpat Singhania (1907-1969) - Second son of Kamlapat Singhania, headed the western zone of business from Mumbai. Instrumental in growth of Raymond Group.{{Cite news|url=http://zeenews.india.com/companies/vijaypat-singhania-here-is-all-you-need-to-know-2031793.html|title=Raymond's ex-tycoon Vijaypat Singhania is now penniless – All you need to know|date=2017-08-10|work=Zee News|access-date=2018-05-07|language=en}} **** [[Vijaypat Singhania]] (born 1938) - Son of Kailashpat Singhania and former Chairman and Managing Director of Raymond Ltd, India. Currently Chairman Emeritus of Raymond Ltd.{{Cite news|url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/V3FLJjBVvmPLLKeDTgODmO/Singhania-vs-Singhania-what-went-wrong.html|title=Singhania vs Singhania: what went wrong?|last=Mishra|first=Ashish K.|date=2015-07-29|access-date=2018-05-06}} ***** [[Gautam Singhania]] (born 1965) - Son of Vijaypat Singhania and current Chairman and Managing Director of [[Raymond Group]] since 1999.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=11688923&privcapId=878483|title=Executive Profile - Gautam Hari Singhania |website=Bloomberg.com|access-date=2018-05-06}} **** [[Anant Singhania]], son of Ajaypat Singhania (Brother of Vijaypat Singhania) is the CEO of JK Enterprises, Director of Platinum Fashion Apparel Limited, Past President of Bombay Management Association, Vice President of IMC Chamber of Commerce and Co Chair of FICCI, [[Maharashtra]] State Council. *** [[Padampat Singhania]] (1904–1979) - Eldest son of Lala Kamlapat Singhania, he continued to manage the companies from Kanpur. He was conferred with knighthood by the British in 1943. He was also the President of JK Organisation until his death.{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/opinion/the-singhania-story/article22994845.ece|title=The Singhania story|work=@businessline|access-date=2018-05-06|language=en}} **** [[Gopal Krishna Singhania]] (1933-1980) - Eldest son of Padampat Singhania and former Chairman Raymonds, JK Synthetics and Vice President of JK Organization.{{Cite magazine |date=December 19, 2014 |title=Gopalkrishna Singhania dies of heart attack at 47 |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine/signposts/story/19800131-gopalkrishna-singhania-dies-of-heart-attack-at-47-821680-2014-12-19 |access-date=2022-03-07 |magazine=India Today |language=en}}{{Cite journal |date=2015-06-05 |title=Shri Gopalkrishna Singhania |url=https://www.epw.in/author/shri-gopalkrishna-singhania |journal=Economic and Political Weekly |language=en |pages=7–8}}{{Cite journal |last=Singhania |first=Gopalkrishna |date=1970 |title=JK Synthetics Limited |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/4360852 |journal=Economic and Political Weekly |volume=5 |issue=51 |pages=2057–2059 |jstor=4360852 |issn=0012-9976}} ***** Ramapati Singhania (born 1956)- Son of Gopal Krishna Singhania. He is the founder and Managing Director of Varal Consultancy, DMCC, Dubai.{{Cite web|title=Ramapati Singhania|url=https://www.darden.virginia.edu/alumni/featured/spotlight/ramapati-singhania|access-date=2022-02-10|website=UVA Darden School of Business|language=en}} **** Gaur Hari Singhania (1935-2015) - Son of Padampat Singhania and former Chairman of JK Group Kanpur.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/panache/jk-group-chairman-gaur-hari-singhania-passes-away/articleshow/46120830.cms|title=JK group Chairman Gaur Hari Singhania passes away|date=2015-02-04|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2018-05-05}} ***** Yadupati Singhania (1953-2020) - Son of Gaur Hari Singhania was the Chairman and Managing Director of JK Cement Ltd. He was an alumnus of [[IIT Kanpur]].{{Cite web|url=http://dora.iitk.ac.in/dora/yadu-pati-singhania-profile|title=Yadu Pati Singhania Profile|website=dora.iitk.ac.in|language=en-gb|access-date=2018-05-05}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profiles/people/15037631-yadupati-singhania|title=Yadupati Singhania, JK Cement Ltd: Profile & Biography - Bloomberg|website=Bloomberg|language=en|access-date=2018-05-05}} **** Govind Hari Singhania (1937-2014) - Son of Padampat Singhania and Director of JK Organisation.{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindu.com/features/metroplus/to-sir-with-love/article2048384.ece|title=To Sir, with love|last=Kumar|first=Anuj|date=2011-05-25|work=The Hindu|access-date=2018-05-05|language=en-IN}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=24918843&capId=877690&previousCapId=20934440&previousTitle=KEY%252520CORP%252520LTD|title=Executive Profile & Biography - Govind Hari Singhania|website=www.bloomberg.com|access-date=2018-05-05}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.pr.com/press-release/611785|title=JK Business School Organises Govind Hari Singhania Memorial Lecture and Alumni Meet|work=PR.com|access-date=2018-05-05}} *** [[Lala Lakshmipat Singhania|Lakshmipat Singhania]] (1910-1976) - Youngest son of Kamlapat Singhania, he headed the northern zone of JK Organisation's businesses. He moved to Kolkata from Kanpur and later on established Delhi as headquarters for businesses under his control. His family controls companies such as [[JK Paper]], JK Laskhmi Cement and [[JK Tyre]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/general-others/president-of-india-launches-special-stamp-of-lala-lakshmipat-singhania-113101603610_1.html|title=President of India launches special stamp of Lala Lakshmipat Singhania|last=indiainfoline.com|access-date=2018-05-06|language=en}} **** [[Hari Shankar Singhania]] (1933-2013) - Son of Lakshmipat Singhania and former Chairman of JK Paper, JK Tyre and JK Lakshmi Cement. He was also on board of several companies and held positions of Director and President for various companies. He was also the President of JK Organisation until his death.{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindu.com/news/national/other-states/jk-organisation-president-hari-shankar-singhania-passes-away/article4445993.ece|title=JK Organisation President Hari Shankar Singhania passes away|date=2013-02-23|work=The Hindu|access-date=2018-05-06|agency=PTI|language=en-IN}} He was awarded [[Padma Bhushan]] - the third-highest [[Indian honours system|civilian award]] in the [[Republic of India]] - in the year 2003. He was also awarded [[Order of the Polar Star|Royal Order of Polar Star]] from the King of Sweden.{{Cite web|url=https://www.paperdiscoverycenter.org/inductees/hari-shankar-singhania/|title=Hari Shankar Singhania – Paper Discovery Center|website=www.paperdiscoverycenter.org|language=en-US|access-date=2018-05-06}} **** Bharat Hari Singhania (born 1939) - Son of Lakshmipat Singhania and current President of JK Organisation. He is also the current Chairman & MD of JK Lakshmi Cement, MD & Executive Director of JK Tyre and Chairman of JK Paper and JK Agri Genetics Ltd.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/stocks|title=Executive Profile - Bharat Hari Singhania|website=Bloomberg.com|access-date=2018-05-06}}{{Cite news|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/bharat-hari-singhania-takes-over-as-jk-organisation-president-115040900989_1.html|title=Bharat Hari Singhania takes over as JK Organisation President|agency=Press Trust of India|date=2015-04-09|work=Business Standard India|access-date=2018-05-06}} ***** Harsh Pati Singhania (born 1961) - Son of Bharat Hari Singhania. He is the current Chairman & MD of JK Paper Limited.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/stocks|title=Executive Profile - Harsh Pati Singhania|website=Bloomberg.com|access-date=2018-05-05}}{{Cite web|url=http://papermart.in/2011/06/13/in-person-with-mr-harshpati-singhania/|title=In Person with Mr. Harshpati Singhania - Papermart|website=papermart.in|date=13 June 2011 |access-date=2018-05-06}} ***** Vikrampati Singhania (born 1967) - Son of Bharat Hari Singhania. He is the Managing Director of JK Fenner (India) Ltd and former Managing Director of JK Tyre from 1997 to 2016. He is also the Managing Director of JK Agri Genetics Limited.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=34389418&privcapId=9933756|title=Executive Profile - Vikrampati Singhania|website=Bloomberg.com|access-date=2018-05-06}} **** Raghupati Singhania (born 1947) - Son of Lakshmipat Singhania. He is the current Chairman & MD of JK Tyre & Industries Limited. extract: The Singhania family is a prominent Indian business family, that started out in the Indian city of Kanpur. The family expanded into three major branches and is currently based out of Kanpur, Mumbai and Delhi. JK Organisation founded by Lala Kamlapat Singhania is one of the largest conglomerates in India today, with multiple million and billion dollar companies under its belt. The family owns majority stakes in several publicly listed companies such as JK Tyre, JK Cement, JK Lakshmi Cement, JK Paper, Jaykay Enterprises, JK Agri Genetics (JK Seeds) and JK Dairy (Umang Dairies). Some privately held companies in the family are Raymond Group, J.K. Ansell, JK Tech, JK Fenner, JK Insurance brokers and Global Strategic Technologies.
